_comments.anthropic-ai/sdk: Caret on a 0.x package pins the MINOR, so ^0.7 would install 0.7.x — not 0.40. Bump this constraint deliberately when upgrading.
_comments.guzzlehttp/guzzle: The SDK requires the virtual packages psr/http-client-implementation and psr/http-factory-implementation but ships no concrete client. Without a real one, `composer install` fails outright. Guzzle 7 provides both (via guzzlehttp/psr7); symfony/http-client + nyholm/psr7 would work equally well.
